title: Reel · ADHD meds and the week before her period
caption:
Your ADHD meds didn't quit. Estrogen dropped.
Estradiol moves dopamine, the system stimulants act on (Hormones and Behavior, 2018). Track symptoms by cycle day for 2 cycles.
Save this. Which day hits hardest?
www.aiforheratx.org
#adhdinwomen #neurodivergent #hormonehealth #pmdd #cycletracking

scenes.text: Rhea, 33, diagnosed at 31. Six days a month she rereads the same email *nine* times.
phrases: Her chai went cold on the shelf above the laundry chair.

scenes.text: Every month, the same six days. Nobody connected it to her cycle, including her.
phrases: It's the same six days. Every single month.

scenes.text: Estradiol tunes *dopamine*, the exact system her meds act on. When it falls, focus falls with it.
phrases: Estradiol tunes *dopamine*, the exact system stimulants act on.
Roberts, Eisenlohr-Moul & Martel, Hormones and Behavior, 2018.
Her labs were normal. It's the drop she reacts to, not the level (NIMH, NEJM 1998).

scenes.text: Two minutes of logging tonight, plus 150 minutes of movement across the week (WHO).
phrases: Log the DRSP tonight: symptoms plus cycle day, two minutes before bed (IAPMD).
Aim for 150 minutes of moderate movement a week, spread across most days (WHO).
Take the log to your prescriber. Nobody has tested dosing by cycle phase, so her record is the data.
